title: Asymmetric solitary waves observed by MMS
text: Identified recurrent asymmetric electrostatic waveforms with unequal bipolar peaks and oscillatory tails. Combining waveform statistics, polarization and propagation diagnostics with particle-in-cell calculations and synthetic spacecraft crossings to distinguish intrinsic asymmetry from viewing geometry and constrain nonlinear structure formation.
status: Observations and initial statistics obtained; kinetic pilot calculations and geometric tests completed; mechanism validation ongoing.

title: Strong perpendicular wave–particle energy transfer in MMS observations
text: Identified intervals of strong perpendicular electric-field–current energy exchange. Using field-aligned decomposition of J·E, plasma-frame diagnostics, wave spectra and particle velocity distributions to assess the role of perpendicular interactions in collisionless energization and distinguish energy exchange from irreversible heating.
status: Event analysis and diagnostic framework developed; cadence, reference-frame and heating checks ongoing.

title: Pair starvation and ion loading in pulsar current sheets
text: Two related manuscripts. Pair starvation: derived current-support bounds under finite particle-energy constraints and examined how ion loading changes the available current. Tearing instability: developed composition and enthalpy criteria to separate bulk ion inertia from direct current-sheet response. These studies constrain when pulsar-wind sheets can sustain current and when ion loading may affect reconnection.
status: Analytical models and manuscript drafts prepared; tearing-specific validation ongoing.

title: Double-layer formation through offset density and temperature gradients
text: Developed a one-dimensional fluid–Poisson framework showing how displaced density and temperature profiles break symmetry and permit a finite potential jump. Derived an offset-dependent voltage scaling and generalized the voltage budget to pressure, inertia and current effects, providing testable criteria for electrostatic particle acceleration.
status: Analytical framework, figures and manuscript draft prepared; numerical validation ongoing.

title: Radio plasma lensing by MHD shocks
text: Combined ion–neutral dispersion analysis, pressure constraints and radio ray tracing to test whether shock-associated plasma sheets can produce extreme scattering events. Calculated lensing light curves and caustic thresholds, identifying a mismatch between assumed sub-AU lens widths and ion–neutral shock scales that constrains viable lens-formation models.
status: Numerical study and technical draft completed; self-consistent lens formation under investigation.

title: MMS search for magnetosheath double layers
text: Compiled a list of MMS magnetosheath intervals containing double-layer. Applying region identification, electric-field morphology, potential-jump and particle-distribution diagnostics to distinguish double layers from bipolar solitary structures and assess localized electron acceleration in the magnetosheath.
status: Interval catalogue and search strategy completed; basic properties such as speed, wavelength, and angle of propagation measured with MMS spacecraft; statistical analysis ongoing.

title: QED-modified inertial Alfvén waves
text: Derived a cold multifluid framework coupling vacuum-polarization corrections to finite-inertia Alfvén waves in magnetized electron–positron–ion plasmas. Established leading-order Hall cancellation and examined weak trace-ion mass loading; extended the model to test whether QED frequency shifts can control resonant instability in streaming plasmas near magnetars.
status: Baseline derivation and extended manuscript draft prepared; resonance and parameter-regime validation ongoing.

title: Ion-acoustic waves in the interstellar medium
text: Investigating the excitation and propagation of ion-acoustic disturbances under interstellar plasma conditions, emphasizing physical existence constraints rather than unrestricted parameter scans. The study uses fluid dispersion analysis and parameter-space mapping to assess how composition, temperature and magnetization govern viable electrostatic modes and their potential role in energy transport.
status: Theoretical study in progress; applicability constraints and manuscript development ongoing.
